metadata.project: Football Wars - 100v100 club and UEFA national simulation

league_selection.scope: Türkiye Süper Lig + 10 other top-flight European leagues
league_selection.choice_note: Top 10 leagues selected editorially, not an official UEFA coefficient top-10 list.

sources.name: beyondELO
sources.role: Club Elo standings; accessed 2026-11-12, pages may be cached

sources.name: FIFA
sources.role: National-team points and global position, 2026-10-07 official edition

metadata.accuracy_note: Club source values transcribed from beyondELO 2026-27 league pages. These are source-derived snapshots, not live feeds. Attributes/tactics are game-design interpretations, not verified real-world tactical metrics.

simulation_engine_recommendation.seed_handling: Use unpredictable crypto random seed per new match; fixed seed allowed for exact replay/export.
simulation_engine_recommendation.team_form_multiplier: Lognormal or truncated normal per match around 1.0; clamp 0.80..1.20
simulation_engine_recommendation.individual_performance_multiplier: Per-unit draw clamp 0.78..1.22, unique per unit and match
simulation_engine_recommendation.soft_cap_strength: Use matchup elo difference with a soft nonlinear cap; never directly multiply raw Elo into damage.

upset_control.note: Use for balancing; do not force upset or predetermine winners.

simulation_engine_recommendation.outcome: Last side with at least one living unit wins. On very rare simultaneous elimination, play sudden-death between each team’s last captain or respawn 1 each.
simulation_engine_recommendation.deterministic_replay: Record seed and fixed-step battle event log; rendering and MP4 export replay same outcome.
simulation_engine_recommendation.copyright: No official logos, player names, club-owned sprite images, or trademarked assets bundled.

sprite_pipeline.fps_note: Sprite animation tick can differ from video frame rate.
